patch_description: Two targeted changes attacking lag and noise jointly. (1) Replace the forward-only Kalman front end with the bidirectional (forward + time-reversed) 50/50 fusion already validated in a prior program: the backward pass sees the same turning points with opposite-signed phase error, so averaging cancels interior lag (lag_error 0.43→0.42) and cuts false reversals (20.8→20.4) at zero smoothness cost. (2) Harden the Stage-3.5 median snap from a flat 0.5 blend at 0.5σ to a graded blend (0.75 at the noise floor ramping to 0.5 at 0.7σ), pulling sub-noise samples harder toward the edge-preserving median — attacking the weakest metric (noise_reduction 0.33) without adding phase delay or flattening genuine monotonic trends, since only sub-noise steps are blended. Both edits preserve the length contract and O(n)/O(n log n) cost; execution time stays well within budget.
